scope: Five source/test paths; workspace feedback only
assessment: list_files reads cached index plus untracked/ignored files from the owned working checkout, deduplicates, omits absent/deleted sparse entries and checks existing file type and all path components against symlinks. Prefix/path length/control checks, 4MiB command-output bound and 500-row truncation retained.

check_workspace only emits four fixed prerequisite codes/messages for missing or invalid package JSON, build command and explicit tests. Arbitrary parse/source/daemon details are not copied into these messages.
Build-script validation becomes stricter for whitespace-only commands and invalid non-object package JSON. Exact revision, isolated test/build and accepted-publication gates remain unchanged.
Hosted prompt explains dependency-free support files for a single published HTML page; no framework, execution mode or permission added.

independentValidation.pattern: workspace listing|workspace prerequisite|finite source prerequisite|source rejects|captures exact|model can check
independentValidation.scope: Actual local Git/file boundaries and production prerequisite rejection before nonexistent Docker; no live model, service, proof or chain operations

limitations: Approval does not establish that the currently running agent has this source or will complete its artifact. No live restart or deployment performed.
